description: The Montreal Canadiens reclaimed the lead in their second-round NHL playoff series on Thursday night, defeating the Buffalo Sabres 6-3 at KeyBank Center.
title: Habs reclaim series lead with 6-3 victory over the Sabres in Game 5

description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set to meet again Friday to wrap up a two-day state visit that has featured pomp and business deals — but also a stark warning from Xi that mishandling the Taiwan issue could ‌push U.S.-China relations to "a very dangerous place."
title: Trump and Xi to meet again after Xi says Taiwan misstep could take ties to 'dangerous place'

description: The father of an 11-year-old boy who died following a dog attack two years ago testified Thursday at the trial of the owner charged in connection with the death.
title: Father of boy killed in Edmonton dog attack testifies at owner’s trial

description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe met with Cuban officials, including Raul Castro's grandson, during a high-level visit to the island Thursday, Cuban and U.S. officials said.
title: CIA chief meets Cuban officials to deliver message: Trump wants 'fundamental changes'

description: Mario Lemieux was ranked the greatest player in major junior hockey history as the Canadian Hockey League unveiled its all-time Top 50 list Thursday.
title: Mario Lemieux named greatest player in Canadian junior hockey history

description: An investigation into Vancouver Mayor Ken Sim's behaviour has found that he breached the city's code of conduct and misused his influence to personally attack Coun. Sean Orr shortly after Orr was elected in 2025.
title: Vancouver mayor 'objectively harassed' city councillor, breached code of conduct, investigation finds
U.S. to slap tariffs on Canadian mushrooms

description: Cuba's electrical grid suffered a partial collapse early on Thursday morning, the country's grid operator UNE said, snuffing out power across eastern Cuba and testing the patience of Cubans already exhausted ‌from seemingly interminable blackouts amid a U.S. fuel blockade.
title: Cuba suffers partial grid failure hours after minister reveals country out of fuel oil, diesel

description: When Kash Patel visited Hawaii last summer, the FBI took pains to note the director was not on vacation, highlighting his walking tour of the bureau's Honolulu field office and meetings with local law enforcement.
title: Emails show Kash Patel working trip to Hawaii included 'VIP Snorkel'

description: Immigration has become a hotly debated topic during Question Period in the House of Commons. CBC’s Fact Check team takes a look at recent claims made by both Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre and Prime Minister Mark Carney.
title: Fact check: Poilievre and Carney on immigration

description: International organization Doctors Without Borders says a Tuesday drone strike that killed two paramedics and injured another in southern Lebanon is part of an "alarming pattern" of Israeli attacks targeting first responders.
title: Israeli attacks on medics in southern Lebanon part of 'alarming pattern,' says MSF

description: Health Canada has recalled several types of climbing harnesses, including some for children, due to faulty buckles and attachments causing fall hazards.
title: Health Canada recalls climbing harnesses due to 'fall hazard' that could cause death

description: More than half of the 118 comments removed by moderators from a map showing possible routes for Canada's proposed high-speed rail project should never have been taken down and will be added back by the end of the week, according to Alto.
title: More than half of comments removed from Alto's high-speed rail map to be reinstated

description: The work of researchers from across Canada is at the heart of a massive new telescope that could help unlock some of the biggest mysteries of the universe from its perch at one of the highest elevations in the world.
title: Canadian-developed technology helps new telescope probe mysteries of the cosmos

description: Multiple outlets reporting Daniel and Henrik Sedin the new co-presidents of the club, Johnson promoted to general manager.
title: Vancouver Canucks poised to name Sedin twins, Ryan Johnson to front office: reports

description: The Canadian Pacific Railway Company has been cleared of all liability in the Lac-Mégantic, Que., train disaster that claimed 47 lives in 2013. Several parties, including the victims and their families, were attempting to sue the rail carrier for its role in the disaster.
title: Canadian Pacific cleared of liability in Lac-Mégantic train disaster

description: Home sales were down four per cent last month compared to April 2025, according to the Canadian Real Estate Association. The national average sale price of a home sold in April was $695,412, up 2.2 per cent from last year.
title: April home sales down amid frosty start to spring real estate market

description: Ever heard of a halftime show… for soccer? Turns out FIFA is aiming to make it a thing at The World Cup final this summer. Shakira, Madonna and K-pop superstar-boy band BTS will headline the first World Cup final halftime show at the Metlife Stadium in New Jersey on July 19, FIFA announced Thursday in an Instagram post.
title: Shakira, Madonna and BTS to headline 1st Super Bowl-style halftime show at World Cup final

description: A 14-year-old from Rivers, Man., now faces charges of conspiracy to commit murder and counselling the offence of murder. He was initially arrested in March after Interpol and the FBI alerted RCMP to online messages about school attacks in Manitoba and Nova Scotia.
title: Manitoba teen accused of planning school attack now charged with conspiracy to commit murder

description: Dr. Joss Reimer, Canada's chief public health officer, is appearing alongside representatives from Global Affairs Canada and Transport Canada on Thursday to take questions about the government's response to hantavirus cases linked to a cruise ship
title: Canada's chief public health officer provides hantavirus update

description: The CBC was blasted on Tuesday for its role in a comedy series that uses fake names and identities to prank individuals who have drawn controversy over their views of residential schools.
title: CBC called out for role in prank interviews of Kamloops residential school grave critics

description: Representatives from the PWHL, Oak View Group, the City of Hamilton and more discuss the PWHL’S expansion to Hamilton. The league now has 11 teams with Hamilton joining Toronto, Ottawa, Montreal and Vancouver as the newest Canadian entry.
title: PWHL expands into Hamilton

description: There’s been a lot of talk about the possibility of a "super" El Niño developing this year, but scientists say not to expect impacts in Canada this summer. That doesn’t mean we get off scott-free.
title: Here's why you don’t need to worry about a 'super' El Niño — yet

description: The countdown to Canada’s World Cup opener on June 12 in Toronto is picking up speed, now only weeks rather than months away. Alphonso Davies, sidelined for the third time since February with a muscle tear, will be wishing for time to stop.
title: Alphonso Davies's return to Canadian lineup complicated by club team Bayern Munich's reported resistance

description: The project, first announced in 2024, was paused last year with plans to review where the EV market was in two years. The indefinite pause comes as Honda posted its first ever full-year loss.
title: Honda indefinitely suspends $15B EV plant in Ontario
Cricket Canada's funding frozen by governing body following fifth estate investigation

description: As the federal government prepares to send seven election observers to Armenia, an advocacy group featuring the former president of Human Rights Watch is warning Canada and its Western allies of democratic backsliding prior to the June vote.
title: As Canada plans to send election observers to Armenia, advocates warn of a democratic backslide

description: Canada wants to build data centres that are not just physically located here, but controlled here — a distinction experts say could determine whether the country can reduce its dependence on U.S. tech giants and keep Canadian data subject to Canadian rules.
title: Canada wants sovereign AI data centres. What does that actually mean?

description: When fires break out in multi-unit buildings in Montreal, tenants vacate and are taken in by the Red Cross. But what happens next can often be a difficult process to navigate for renters. Housing advocates worry these fires are leading to permanent displacement of tenants — and reshaping neighbourhoods in the process.
title: How fires are permanently displacing Montrealers and reshaping neighbourhoods

description: Letters notifying resellers of inspection were sent out last week, and investigators are starting to inspect ticket resellers and big companies like StubHub this week, according to Minister of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement Stephen Crawford. But resale sites say they're still looking for guidance on how to implement the rules.
title: Ontario starts crackdown on ticket resale above face value

description: The PWHL announced an expansion to Hamilton Wednesday, alongside an expansion to Las Vegas. Local fans and players say it will be great to cheer for a home team.
title: PWHL to introduce Hamilton franchise, fans thrilled to cheer for new pro hockey team

description: The rise in home invasions in Toronto over the last few years is largely due to a significant increase in home invasions involving houses in some of the city's wealthiest neighbourhoods, according to a CBC News analysis of Toronto police data. Residents of those neighbourhoods have been taking matters into their own hands.
title: Rise in Toronto home invasions tied to houses in some of city's wealthiest neighbourhoods

description: A continuing care organization in Nova Scotia has rescinded job offers it had been extending to refugees for more than two years, leaving the displaced people without a path out of some of the largest refugee camps in the world. They were invited to come to Canada through a federal program, but the organization says as processing timelines and the number of people needing care increased, many of the roles were filled locally.
title: These refugees in Kenya were promised jobs in Canada. At the 11th hour, the employer cancelled the offer
